owner_concurrency: Reproduced rollback-journal disappearance between exists() and lstat(); regression failed before fix. One lstat now handles only FileNotFoundError as optional absence. Unsafe entries and actual lock/storage errors remain fail-closed. Controlled writer-lock/revocation test verifies current auth after waiting. 20 unchanged pre-fix stress runs passed; historical CI causality cannot be proven from a generic sanitized error alone. Twenty independent post-fix executions of existing concurrency and both timing regressions also passed without retries.
